meta.title: Pratham Aalo · Dawn — a learning collective
meta.description: A Bengal-rooted learning collective. Children learn in Bengali, in their own place, through doing. We hope to open a school in ~5 years. No master plan — learning as we go.

brand.descriptor: Pratham Aalo · Dawn — a learning collective

hero.lede: A small group of friends learning how to build a place where every child in Bengal can learn in their own language, at their own pace, through doing. In about five years, we hope to open a school.
hero.tagline: We don't have a master plan. We are learning as we go.
hero.note: Not a school yet · Not registered yet · Not accepting donations

belief.label: Core belief
belief.sub: Every child noticed, in their mother tongue, in their own place.

pillars.d: Visit schools, sit with families, ask what is truly needed — slowly, in Bengali.
Cooking, fixing a toy, counting money, block print. Everything is education.
Stories, comics, leaflets and teacher aids shared freely through NGOs.

honesty.title: Honestly, where we are
honesty.line: We are a thought with a concrete plan and initiative — not a registered organisation yet. No school yet. No site chosen. No donations.

roadmapTeaser.kicker: Five years to a school · target ≈ 2031
roadmapTeaser.title: Each phase, a brighter sunrise

joinCta.title: Come learn with us
joinCta.sub: Everyone does a bit of everything. One skill, one evening a week is enough to begin.

footer.tagline: We don't have a master plan. We are learning as we go.
